amendment_01.superseded_run: g17p_20260830_supp01 -- launched in the background and then overlapped by this experiment's own danger arm. RETAINED as it stopped, used for no verdict, replaced under new ids.
amendment_01.what: THREE supplementary arms added AFTER run01/run02, each a SECOND independent carrier for a field already swept -- never a re-run of a case already recorded.
amendment_01.why: mov_zext16.src_reg/src_flag were inert in ONE usable carrier, which is not enough to call an inert field emitter-grade (the falu2.srcA_reg_top precedent required six families).

amendment_02.STATUS: BUILT AND COMMITTED BUT NOT RUN
amendment_02.kept_in_its_own_list: SUPP2_ARMS, so the supp02/supp03 pair's frozen matrix hash stays exactly what those runs executed.
amendment_02.what: A FOURTH arm, D4_FSPEC_FLOOR, built to test db.json's round-family round-mode enum (0 nearest / 2 floor / 4 ceil / 6 trunc) by computed value on a `floor` carrier.
amendment_02.why_not_run: this experiment had already caused 1,571 contained `ErrorHang` command buffers (RESULTS.md section 8.1), each of which resets the device for every other agent. `roundmode` is already `hardware-run` from three carriers; refining the round-family enum did not justify more GPU load. Run it with `harness/run.py --supp2`.

amendment_03.result: 58 of 60 confirmed; 2 were not faults (3.3% unlocked-run false-fault rate). Both corrections applied before the verdicts were computed.
amendment_03.what: Fault adjudication was SAMPLED, not exhaustive: 60 of the 308 fault-agreeing cases, stratified across all 12 (arm, field) strata, 5x each.
amendment_03.why: re-running all 308 costs ~1,540 dispatches, a large share of them device-resetting, and NO field verdict in analysis/field_verdicts.json rests on a `fault` classification -- every accept-rule is an `ok` set.

amendment_04.fix: harness/run.py now treats an attempt whose OS error string contains `ErrorHang` as a genuine hang for the stop rule. Committed, but AFTER the runs above were made.
amendment_04.impact: 1,571 contained ErrorHang command buffers over 30,056 dispatched cases; 0 watchdog hangs; 0 host wedges; the neo stayed healthy throughout.
amendment_04.rule: PRE_REGISTRATION section 2 H6 / section 4: two GENUINE hangs stop an arm.
amendment_04.what: DEVIATION FROM A PRE-REGISTERED SAFETY RULE, disclosed.
amendment_04.what_happened: the rule was implemented against the runner's watchdog `HANG` status, while every genuine hang in this experiment arrived as a CONTAINED `CMDBUF_ERROR` carrying the OS string `kIOGPUCommandBufferCallbackErrorHang`. The rule therefore never fired: the danger arm ran all 64 values instead of stopping at two, and E2_FSPEC_EST_RCP produced ~300 ErrorHangs per run across three runs.
